config.fabric_client_privacy.title: Fabric Client Privacy
config.fabric_client_privacy.enabled.too: Turn all privacy protections on or off.
config.fabric_client_privacy.brand.toolt: Send the vanilla client brand instead of the modded client brand.
config.fabric_client_privacy.channels.to: Hide optional mod channels from the list announced to the server.
config.fabric_client_privacy.packs.toolt: Only confirm matching built-in Minecraft packs.
config.fabric_client_privacy.signs.toolt: Hide mod translations from supported US-English sign probes.
config.fabric_client_privacy.payloads.to: Block unapproved custom login replies and mod packets.
config.fabric_client_privacy.debug.toolt: Log privacy events without logging packet contents.
config.fabric_client_privacy.allowlist.t: Allow specific channels to be announced or send data.
config.fabric_client_privacy.allowlist.l: Enter one exact channel ID per line.
config.fabric_client_privacy.rejoin: Rejoin the server to apply login and channel changes.
config.fabric_client_privacy.save_failed: Could not save. Check the client log and try again.
